title: A Day in Hungary - Egy nap Magyarországon
grammar: connect a full day, present and past, using Units 1-2 and 24-25 together

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can describe a whole day in Hungarian, from morning to night, linking the parts with time words.
I can tell someone what I did yesterday, weaving several actions together in natural past tense.
